goal: Allow users to connect bitcoin-gui to a running background bitcoin-node process via IPC
Enable starting and stopping the GUI independently without terminating the node daemon
agreement: General support for independent GUI lifecycles over IPC (laanwj, meshcollider, Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: bitcoin-gui assertion failure crash with external signers or PSBTs (Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: bitcoin-node crashes if GUI connects without -disablewallet (jimhashhq)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it allows attaching and detaching GUI sessions to a persistent background node daemon
Advances process separation milestones by decoupling the GUI lifecycle from the node lifecycle
